Independent bytes verify asymmetric FIR/voxel order, explicit physical metadata, sparse selected maps/extensions, existing-target preservation and callback resource closure. New160MB/40million-value probe passes -Xmx64m; Python independently checks every value and analytic checksum19919995270, SHA2569585f6bdbbc9ff3f32567c33cd2df9c9f573b2216eb76ac3d3d2198e35700aac.

Remaining: reconcile recent selected-estimate/response-basis work onto canonical providers, qualify it, then implement scientific output binding/transactional sink/catalog and app W5. Read-only selected-fit patch check from702ecd9 found one textual conflict at MatrixAdapters.scala; no scientific forward-port was applied. Current canonical fit test counts do not qualify absent recent selected-fit code. Fresh remote clone cannot resolve pinned reframe4s53a5c3c; tests used an exact local archive, so remote dependency availability remains required before admission. Local JDK25/Node26 proof only. Incremental .nii staging requires RAS and first-axis-fastest indices; header sampling follows explicit options. Labels, physical nonzero FIR origins, completeness and publication remain caller-owned scientific metadata/lifecycle. No old image aliases or affine-equality workaround were adopted.
